# kernel size=11, out_channels=96, in_channels=3.

    def conv2d_fp16_tiled(
        A: T.Buffer[(T.int64, T.int64, T.int64, T.int64), "float16"],   # (N, C, H, W)
        Wt: T.Buffer[(T.int64, T.int64, T.int64, T.int64), "float16"], # (K, C, R, S)
        B: T.Buffer[(T.int64, T.int64, T.int64, T.int64), "float16"]   # (N, K, P, Q)
    ):
        """Direct convolution with explicit padding handling."""
        stride = T.int64(4)
        pad = T.int64(2)
        R = T.int64(11)
        S = T.int64(11)

        N = A.shape[0]
        C = A.shape[1]
        H = A.shape[2]
        W = A.shape[3]
        K = Wt.shape[0]

        P = (H + 2 * pad - R) // stride + 1
        Q = (W + 2 * pad - S) // stride + 1

        for n, k, p, q in T.grid(N, K, P, Q):
            with T.block("conv"):
                vn, vk, vp, vq = T.axis.remap("SSSS", [n, k, p, q])
                rc = T.axis.reduce(C)
                rr = T.axis.reduce(R)
                ss = T.axis.reduce(S)

                acc = T.float32(0.0)
                for rc, rr, ss in T.grid(C, R, S):
                    in_h = vp * stride + rr - pad
                    in_w = vq * stride + ss - pad
                    a_val = T.if_then_else(
                        T.all(in_h >= 0, in_h < H, in_w >= 0, in_w < W),
                        T.Cast("float32", A[vn, rc, in_h, in_w]),
                        T.float32(0.0)
                    )
                    w_val = T.Cast("float32", Wt[vk, rc, rr, ss])
                    acc = acc + a_val * w_val
                B[vn, vk, vp, vq] = T.Cast("float16", acc)

    # Build the kernel for the target GPU
    target = "cuda -arch=sm_120"
    dev = tvm.runtime.cuda(0)
    conv2d_fp16_mod = tvm_build.build(conv2d_fp16_tiled, target=target, name="conv2d_fp16")
else:  # pragma: no cover
    # Dummy placeholder – never called when TVM is missing.
    conv2d_fp16_mod = None

            self.in_channels,
            self.kernel_size,
            self.kernel_size,
            dtype=torch.float16,
            device="cuda",
        )
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(weight)

        R = S = self.kernel_size
        stride = self.stride
        pad = self.padding
        P = (H + 2 * pad - R) // stride + 1
        Q = (W + 2 * pad - S) // stride + 1

            w_tvm = tvm.runtime.ndarray.from_dlpack(w)
            b_tvm = tvm.runtime.ndarray.from_dlpack(out)

                w,
                bias=None,
                stride=self.stride,
                padding=self.padding,

    num_classes = 1000
